description: Learn world capitals with plausible city and town choices from the same country, or nearby capitals for city-states.
updateNotes: All 196 questions now have three curated wrong answers, mostly cities and towns from the same country. Monaco, Singapore, and Vatican City use nearby capitals. Outdated capital answers are corrected, and questions with multiple capitals specify the role being asked. Your edits and practice history are preserved.
attribution: City names adapted from GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Choices curated on 2026-10-09; source records retained below for verification.

legacy-card-1519.question: Burundi (political capital)
legacy-card-1519.notes: Gitega is the political capital; Bujumbura remains the economic capital.

legacy-card-1546.notes: Ciudad de la Paz replaced Malabo as the capital in January 2026.

legacy-card-1613.notes: Also spelled Nay Pyi Taw. Yangon (formerly Rangoon) was the previous capital.

legacy-card-1615.question: Nauru (seat of government)
legacy-card-1615.notes: Government offices are in Yaren district; Nauru has no officially designated capital.

legacy-card-1625.notes: The national government moved from Koror to Ngerulmud, in Melekeok State, in 2006.

legacy-card-1653.question: South Africa (administrative capital)
legacy-card-1653.notes: Pretoria is the administrative capital; Cape Town is legislative and Bloemfontein is judicial.

legacy-card-1655.question: Sri Lanka (legislative capital)
legacy-card-1655.notes: Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte is the legislative capital. Colombo also has major government functions.

legacy-card-1658.question: Eswatini (administrative capital)
legacy-card-1658.notes: Mbabane is the administrative capital. Lobamba is the royal and legislative capital.

legacy-card-1684.question: Western Sahara (main administrative city)
legacy-card-1684.notes: El Aaiun (Laayoune) is the main administrative city. The territory's status is disputed.
